successCriteria.description: src/modules/notification/notification.service.ts exists and exports a NotificationService class exposing exactly five methods: create, findByRecipient, findByEntity, updateStatus, markRead.

Each service method delegates to the injected repository method of the same name and forwards the optional PoolClient as the last parameter (create/updateStatus/markRead), while read methods (findByRecipient/findByEntity) pass no client.
The service constructor accepts an optional INotificationRepository and defaults to `new NotificationRepository()` when none is supplied.
Repository errors (e.g. NotificationNotFoundError, INVALID_NOTIFICATION RepositoryError) propagate unchanged through the service — no catching, wrapping, or transformation.

constraints: The service is a thin synchronous delegating facade: it adds no business logic, no validation, no audit writes, and no transaction orchestration of its own.
No background fanout (no BullMQ/queue) — the service only delegates to NotificationRepository.
The service must not import the pg Pool or any module-level db helper; it only receives/forwards the optional PoolClient parameter.
Only src/modules/notification/notification.service.ts is created — no index.ts, no errors.ts, no service interface file, no tests.
outOfScope: Creating notification.model.ts and notification.repository.ts (Phase 6a sibling deliverable).
Unit/integration tests for the notification service or repository (Phase 6c sibling deliverable).
Creating index.ts, errors.ts, or a separate service interface file for the notification module.
Background notification fanout / BullMQ job scheduling.

entityInvariants.invariant: The service is stateless beyond its injected repository reference and never mutates or re-shapes the Notification entities it returns.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Delegates to repository.create; INVALID_NOTIFICATION (mismatched relatedEntityType/relatedEntityId) propagates unchanged.
Delegates to repository.updateStatus; NotificationNotFoundError (NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND) propagates unchanged when no row matches.
Delegates to repository.markRead; sets status=READ and stamps read_at; NotificationNotFoundError propagates unchanged when no row matches.
Delegates to repository.findByRecipient; returns Notification[] (possibly empty), no client forwarded.
Delegates to repository.findByEntity; returns Notification[] (possibly empty), no client forwarded.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Service method names and signatures must mirror INotificationRepository exactly (create, findByRecipient, findByEntity, updateStatus, markRead), including the optional PoolClient last parameter on write methods.
Import Notification and CreateNotificationInput types from the notification model; do not re-declare them.
Import NotificationStatus from the shared types module (not re-declared locally).
Follow the established thin-facade service pattern: constructor injection defaulting to the concrete repository, methods delegating directly and forwarding the optional PoolClient.
NotificationNotFoundError and RepositoryError are declared in the repository file and imported from the employee module's public entry point respectively — the service must not re-declare them.

integrationPoints.why: The service delegates all five operations to this repository interface.
